project_info.theme: 1920s tailored portrait in a narrow atmospheric alley
project_info.color_palette: charcoal gray, black, crisp white, weathered red brick, cool shadows

main_subject.type: adult person using a required approved-adult face reference
main_subject.detail: An adult person whose face, facial structure, proportions, features, and expression match the attached approved-adult reference. They have black hair and a neatly groomed black beard when present in the reference, and are styled in 1920s fashion: a gray tweed newsboy cap, black waistcoat over a crisp white shirt, slim black tie, black leather gloves, and a heavy wool overcoat draped over one shoulder.

items: medium shot leaning against a weathered brick wall in a narrow alley
face turned upward with a cool contemplative expression
round sunglasses as a central accessory
tailored waistcoat, crisp shirt, tie, gloves, cap, and draped overcoat clearly visible
brick alley recedes softly behind the subject

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: soft shadows create depth and mystery while preserving garment texture

technical_specs.render_style: ultra-detailed sharp-focus cinematic portrait with shallow depth of field
technical_specs.color_treatment: cool controlled tones, natural skin texture, soft background falloff

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Use the attached approved-adult face reference as the sole identity standard; preserve the adult person's face, facial structure, proportions, features, and expression accurately without celebrity or public-figure substitution. Create a hyper-realistic cinematic medium shot of the subject styled in 1920s fashion: a gray tweed newsboy cap, black waistcoat over a crisp white shirt, slim black tie, black leather gloves, and a heavy wool overcoat draped over one shoulder. Have the person lean against a weathered brick wall in a narrow atmospheric alleyway, looking upward with a cool contemplative expression through round sunglasses. Use moody dramatic cool lighting, soft shadows, sharp focus, shallow depth of field, and a sense of depth and mystery.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, sexual pose, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, identity blending, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach a required approved-adult face reference. Preserve the adult facial identity and the 1920s newsboy cap, waistcoat, white shirt, tie, gloves, draped wool coat, round sunglasses, brick wall, and upward contemplative pose. Do not use celebrity/public-figure likeness.
